entry.title: New: dsh-devtoolbox
entry.summary: Local toolbox for the DSH web GUI: 35 pure-client tools (text, encoding, hashing, extraction, conversion, reference tables) in a sidebar view, plus the /toolbox command and config-driven agent tool exposure. Exact install spec: dsh-devtoolbox. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
